claims.text: When it is used Brain perfusion tests (or EEG) can add evidence of absent brain blood flow, but are not usually required
claims.quote: Sometimes EEG or tests of brain perfusion are used to confirm absence of brain activity or brain blood flow and thus provide additional evidence to family members, but these tests are not usually required.

claims.text: They are used when apnea testing is not tolerated hemodynamically, or when only one neurologic exam is wanted
claims.quote: They are indicated when apnea testing is not hemodynamically tolerated and when only 1 neurologic examination is desirable

claims.text: Reading it Brain death pattern: technetium-99m HMPAO brain scanning (or angiography, or transcranial Doppler in adults) shows no intracranial blood flow
claims.quote: Conventional angiography, transcranial Doppler ultrasonography (to be used only in adults; not yet validated in children), or technetium-99m hexamethylpropyleneamine oxime brain scanning shows no intracranial blood flow.
claims.locator: Criteria for Determination of Brain Death in Adults, item 8

claims.text: Radionuclide scans also image the cerebrovascular system
claims.quote: Radionuclide scanning is also used to image the thyroid gland and the cerebrovascular, cardiovascular, respiratory, and genitourinary systems.
